notes: A tanker flying a refuelling track now extends the reach of every jet that can take fuel in flight (strike fighters, carrier air wings, bombers, A-10s and AC-130s) whose base is within reach of the track: they fly out, top off and fight from there, out to about 85% of their normal radius beyond the track. On the air-cover overlay the ring stretches into a long capsule toward each track. Strike boxes, fire missions, strike targets and air patrol stations all use the stretched reach
Drones, patrol aircraft and transports cannot refuel in flight and get no tanker bonus. Fixed-wing aircraft reach about 20% farther than before
